title: Adaptive Quantization Field Lab & Rollout Playbook
creator: Anika Rao
description: Objective: run a targeted field lab for adaptive quantization profiles to validate cost/perf/quality trade-offs and produce an operational rollout playbook. This work covers: (1) build of per-model quantization profiles and compatibility tests, (2) canary orchestration and automated fallback rules in the Console, (3) evaluation harness for semantic regression (prompt suites + embedding similarity), and (4) a runbook for production rollouts and escalation. Success means measurable token-cost reduction with no more than 2% customer-visible quality regressions on monitored prompt cohorts and established automatic rollback triggers. The playbook will include gating thresholds, telemetry dashboards, canary ramp schedule, and remediation steps for discovered regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Field lab run completed on three representative models (chat, completion, embeddings) with per-model profiles recorded
Automated canary policy implemented in Console with cohort selection, 5-step ramp, and automated fallback when quality or error thresholds breached
Quality regression checks integrated into eval harness with daily snapshot reporting; baseline and post-quant metrics stored in metrics-db
Runbook drafted and reviewed by Eng and SRE, including rollback, incident playbook, and customer communication templates
Cost telemetry shows >=15% token-econ improvement on combined traffic for at least one model variant without exceeding quality guardrail
updates: 2025-11-18: Kickoff with Eng, SRE, and DX. Agreed scope: start with two model families (llama-like 30B and an embedding model) and one traffic slice (internal + opt-in external).
2026-01-05: Engineering delivered initial quantization profiles and a compatibility matrix. Found one kernel mismatch on the 30B family; ENG created PR #4682 to add a fallback kernel path.

2026-01-28: Ran internal canary (10% internal traffic). Early results: ~22% token-cost reduction, p50 latency improved, p95 latency +6ms on high-token sequences. Noted small quality drift on a subset of long-context prompts.

2026-02-12: Design and Product reviewed regression examples. Decision: implement selective per-prompt fallback based on prompt fingerprinting and confidence signals. Added labeled tickets for dataset expansion (ENG-1947) and fingerprinting feature (ENG-2075).
2026-02-25: Security review scoping started due to per-customer profile changes; Sec requested encryption-at-rest for profile storage. Security review assigned to Priya Kapoor.

2026-03-03: Canary adjusted to route only low-risk customers; automated rollback rule added (if semantic-similarity drop > 3% or error-rate spike > 1.5% over 24h). Preparing to expand to 10% external opt-in on 2026-03-20.
Action items: finalize runbook, add dashboards for prompt-cohort tracking, complete security sign-off, schedule customer comms with Solutions for opt-in cohort.
